title: alcea biennis subsp. cretica
intro: Alcea biennis subsp. cretica, commonly known as the biennial hollyhock, is a subspecies of the biennial hollyhock plant, native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and skin conditions. The health benefits of Alcea biennis subsp. cretica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, which can help soothe digestive issues and promote skin health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
